The patch operates solely within the expected scope of package installation—copying files to standard system directories—and does not introduce any network operations, code execution, file exfiltration, or unexpected system modifications. The change represents a functional or policy decision about configuration management rather than a supply-chain attack. It does not bypass security controls, drop payloads, or access sensitive data. There is no executable code, script, or command in this file. The modifications are limited to source code includes and are consistent with upstream library evolution. The changes do not introduce any network operations, file system manipulations, or suspicious system calls. The patch operates solely within the expected scope of the plugin's build and functionality.

Such include adjustments are common when adapting plugins to newer library versions and pose no security risk. The patch does not alter program logic, add backdoors, or enable data exfiltration. It is a routine development update.
